SK03-q01-rei928: 3 is the number of attempts, not errors; you may make up to 30 errors.
Critical errors don't count as 2; any critical driving error is an automatic failure.
SK03-q02-wujwj9: Being under 30 errors doesn't help; any critical driving error is an automatic failure.
There is no redo; a critical driving error ends the test as a failure.
SK03-q03-if7g9s: Speed is not coasting; unsafe coasting is being out of gear for more than your vehicle's length.
Easing off the accelerator is normal; coasting means being out of gear (clutch in or Neutral).
SK03-q04-qlgzov: Too close; stop where you can see the rear tires of the vehicle ahead.
50 feet is the railroad crossing maximum, not the gap behind a stopped vehicle.
SK03-q05-sib87o: Turned wheels are a trap; keep the front wheels straight ahead until you start the turn.
Wheels stay pointed straight ahead while waiting, not toward the curb.
SK03-q06-5zhm0b: A green light is not enough; don't enter unless there is room to clear the intersection.
Waiting inside the intersection blocks cross traffic; don't enter until you can clear it.
SK03-q07-1hsaqr: The test asks for a change to the left, then back to the right.
You are asked to change lanes left, then back right, not to stay put.
SK03-q08-qbzbfd: Cancel the turn signal once stopped and use the 4-way flashers instead.
Take your feet off the brake and clutch after setting the parking brake.
SK03-q09-pdoiav: Don't turn the wheel before the vehicle moves; pull straight ahead first.
Turn the 4-way flashers off before pulling out, then use the left signal.
SK03-q10-5n5by8: Braking in the curve is the trap; slow down before it so no braking or shifting is needed.
Slowing after the curve is too late; slow down before you enter it.
SK03-q11-ddvhqa: Too close; stop no less than 15 feet from the nearest rail.
More than 50 feet is too far; stop no more than 50 feet from the nearest rail.
SK03-q12-ozq8tw: Both hands on the wheel is required while crossing, so it is allowed.
Checking traffic is always expected; it is not banned in the crossing.
SK03-q13-era412: The flashers stay on through the stop and crossing; turn them off after crossing.
Flashers stay on while crossing; turn them off only after you cross the tracks.
SK03-q14-7c8s5d: Posted clearance is asked after an overpass; after a bridge it is the weight limit.
Bridge length is not asked; the examiner may ask the posted weight limit.
SK03-q15-p25n2w: It isn't simply skipped; you may be asked to explain and demonstrate it at a simulated location.
You don't return another day; the procedure can be simulated on the same test.
SK03-q16-aphl0x: Keep both hands on the wheel on expressways too; the only exception is shifting.
Both hands stay on the wheel in turns; the only exception is while shifting.
SK03-q17-103lgy: Always use the clutch to shift; never shift without it.
Don't shift in turns; an unsynchronized transmission needs double-clutching.
SK03-q18-pqjiiz: Don't pump the brakes; brake smoothly with steady pressure.
Resting your foot on the pedal is riding the brake, which is scored as a mistake.
SK03-q19-154gxe: The curb lane is where a right turn ends; a left turn ends right of the center line.
Not any lane; finish a left turn in the lane directly right of the center line.
SK03-q20-6tjuwx: Choosing a gear that doesn't rev or lug the engine is the correct habit.
Changing gears before the turn is correct; shifting inside the turn is the mistake.
SK03-q21-lajh9s: 10,001 lb is too light; Class B needs a single vehicle with a GVWR of 26,001 lb or more.
A car towing a trailer is not a single vehicle; Class B needs a single vehicle of 26,001 lb or more.
